question: ap1
prompt:
Each of your ideas must draw on a domain unrelated to the research question below, for example through an analogy, a structure, a principle, or a pattern borrowed from that domain, while still being a concrete, scientifically sound way to address the question.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Hysteresis loop mapping (ferromagnetism / materials science)
ideas.description: Ramp a stimulus such as TGF-beta, serum, or a drug up in graded steps and then back down, measuring AP-1 target accessibility and reporter output in single cells at each step. A split between the ascending and descending branches is the signature of history dependence; test AP-1 dependence by attempting to collapse the loop with A-Fos or a FOS/JUN degron.

ideas.title: Lineage-barcoded pedigree tracking (population genetics / heritability estimation)
ideas.description: Use clonal barcoding plus single-cell ATAC and RNA to compute the heritability of AP-1 site accessibility across cell divisions and sister-cell pairs, partitioning variance into clone-of-origin versus noise. Formal heritability and decay-half-life-across-generations statistics convert a vague memory claim into an estimated persistence timescale.

ideas.title: Write/erase/read latency benchmarking (computer memory engineering)
ideas.description: Treat the AP-1 site as a storage device by delivering pulsed optogenetic FOS/JUN dimerization of defined amplitude and duration, then assaying retention time, minimum write duration, and the recall advantage on a second stimulus. Plotting retention versus write parameters distinguishes a bistable latch from a leaky capacitor or a pure relay.

ideas.title: Savings paradigm at the moment of recall (Ebbinghaus memory psychology)
ideas.description: Psychological memory is measured by faster relearning rather than spontaneous recall, so prime cells, wait until the transcriptional response fully returns to baseline, then re-stimulate and measure response latency and amplitude. Degrading AP-1 selectively during the silent interval versus during recall separates AP-1 as the stored trace from AP-1 as the readout machinery.

ideas.title: Serial passaging as an epidemiological cohort (survival analysis)
ideas.description: Follow single-cell-derived clones with differing initial AP-1 activity as a longitudinal cohort, using Cox proportional-hazards models in which the event is loss of the primed phenotype such as drug tolerance or accessibility state. Covariates like AP-1 motif occupancy, partner TF identity, and CpG methylation reveal which features predict durable versus transient memory.
